newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Shipping privatisation into final round.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Shipping privatisation into final round.

text.p: Two consortia on Thursday made bids in the second and final round of offers for the Estonian Shipping Company, one of the largest companies up for sale in the Baltic state, the privatisation agency said.
The two groups are Arbonale, which includes Nomura, Jinhui Shipping and Transport and Norwegian company Marsoft, and a group led by local investment house Baltic Cresco.
"We can say there were two bids in the box when it was opened," privatisation agency information office Silva Mannik told Reuters.
The consortia have not revealed how much they have bid for the company, which has a fleet of 47 ships, 2,400 employees and assets at the end of 1996 of 1.3 billion kroons.
Mannik said that a decision on the winner of the privatisation competition may be announced on June 11.

Hansa Investments, advising the Arbonale consortium, said that it has also made a strategic deal with local port handling company N-Terminal to help develop the transit capabilities of the company if they win the bid.
